EmailTemplate.description: Your major change request has been completed.
EmailTemplate.name: Major Change Approved Email - ONLINE
EmailTemplate.subject: Major Change Approved
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
We have received your request to switch your major and the change has been completed. You can view this update on My ASU under My Programs and eAdvisor.
While you are in My ASU, please take a moment to review any additional items you may have to complete toward your enrollment at ASU.
If you have any questions, please contact ASU Online at enrollment@asuonline.asu.edu.
Sincerely,
Admission Services
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
